description: This file is a C source code for a partition table generator tool called 'ptgen'. It includes functions for parsing partition sizes, converting sector numbers to CHS format, rounding sectors, and generating a partition table, along with a main function that processes command-line arguments and writes the partition table to a file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, processes command-line arguments, and calls gen_ptable to generate the partition table.

methods.name: gen_ptable
methods.description: Generates the partition table based on provided signature and number of partitions, writes to output file.

methods.name: to_kbytes
methods.description: Parses a size string with optional K, M, G suffixes and returns size in kilobytes.

methods.name: to_chs
methods.description: Converts sector number into CHS (Cylinder-Head-Sector) format for partition table entries.

methods.name: round_to_cyl
methods.description: Rounds sector number up to the next cylinder boundary.

methods.name: round_to_kb
methods.description: Rounds sector number up to the nearest kb_align boundary.
